extraction_notes: The job identity was preserved exactly: frozen campaign order 940, LCSC C5443713, MPN AP40P04G, manufacturer ALLPOWER ShenZhen Quan Li Semiconductor, family mosfet.
The canonical PDF identifies AP40P04G as a P-Channel Enhancement Mosfet and shows revision V1.0. All six PDF pages were examined.
Signed P-channel voltage and current values are stored as magnitudes in numeric fields, while the published signs are retained in conditions strings.
Typical Performance Characteristics Figures 1 through 6 were digitized conservatively from visible plotted traces; curve temperatures are stated only where the figure explicitly labels them.
Electrical-characteristics values retain their published minimum, typical, or maximum provenance. RDS(on) resistance is retained in the table's published mΩ unit.
